title: Antoine Lucas' Brand for Quarto Documents and Shiny Apps
text: Antoine Lucas’ brand R package — bundles al-brand Quarto brand extension (sky-blue identity, Space Grotesk / DM Sans / JetBrains Mono, paired light + dark modes) R workflow can produce branded outputs: one-function report rendering, Quarto project scaffolding, Shiny theming. Pattern inspired Mickaël Canouil (@mcanouil) work shipping Quarto extensions inside R packages deliver branded reports R Shiny workflows — see https://github.com/mcanouil https://mickael.canouil.fr/.
